job.title: Experienced Associate Chiropractor
job.description:
Company Description

Join our state-of-the-art wellness practice located near Spring, Texas. Our open-concept, hands-on chiropractic clinic utilizes diversified, Thompson, and Activator techniques. We prioritize hands-on adjustments as the core of our treatment plans, supplemented with adjunct therapies as needed. Each patient receives an individualized care plan tailored to their specific needs.

Deliver expert chiropractic adjustments using diversified, Thompson, and Activator techniques. Provide individualized, hands-on care for a diverse range of patients. Collaborate within a supportive, patient-centered team environment.

Qualifications

  • Active Texas chiropractic license (or application in process).
  • Humble, skilled adjuster with strong commitment to patient outcomes.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

Other Information

  • Compensation: Base salary $87,000 annually + signing bonus.
  • Comprehensive insurance package included.
  • Relocation stipend available for the right candidate.

job.title: Performance & Wellness Chiropractor
job.description:
Company Description

Our established chiropractic clinic has served the community for more than a decade and is located on the outskirts of Boston in a smaller-town setting. The practice maintains a holistic, patient-centered atmosphere with a strong emphasis on wellness care and sports-focused patients. We operate in a collaborative environment alongside other chiropractors and offer shared staff support, treatment equipment, computer systems, and a spacious reception area.

Job Description

We are currently seeking a Full-Time Chiropractor to join our growing practice within the next 1-3 months. The office maintains a steady patient flow while emphasizing quality care and patient relationships. Care plans are tailored to patient progress.

We are looking for a doctor who is personable, growth-oriented, and comfortable participating in patient education and community engagement. Our clinic combines chiropractic adjustments with supportive therapies and values providers familiar with adjunctive modalities.

Key Details:

Average patient volume: 21-30 patients daily
Comprehensive EHR/charting system
Modalities and adjusting both commonly utilized
Familiarity with Heat/Cold therapies and other adjunctive therapies

Qualifications

  • Adjustment-focused clinician
  • Community-oriented and personable
  • Business-minded and growth-focused
  • Open-minded and team-oriented
  • Full-time availability preferred
  • Values strong adjusting ability alongside professionalism

Other Information

  • Salary range: $75,000-$85,000 including incentives
  • Potential retirement benefits
  • Continuing education support may be available
  • Open to all experience levels

job.description:
Company Description

We are an independent chiropractic practice located in a suburban setting . The practice has been established for more than 10 years and offers a traditional, welcoming office environment.

Our patient base includes general wellness care with a focus on accident recovery. Familiarity with Drop Table, Diversified, Activator, Graston, Flexion-Distraction, E-Stim, and Heat/Cold therapies is helpful.

Office features include staff support, private adjusting rooms, a large waiting room, shared office space, treatment equipment, and an established patient base.

Job Description

We are seeking a full-time Doctor of Chiropractic with an entrepreneurial mindset and an interest in potentially transitioning into an ownership role.

This position is best suited for a doctor who wants to help grow the practice, build patient relationships, and become part of the long-term future of the clinic. For the right candidate, we are open to discussing a path toward ownership or practice purchase, structured in a way that works well for everyone involved.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable not only seeing patients, but also participating in practice growth. Mentorship will be provided, and over time we will evaluate how well the doctor connects with patients, builds the schedule, and contributes to the overall growth of the practice.

Qualifications

  • Must be licensed or eligible for chiropractic licensure in Oregon.
  • Insurance panel credentialing is preferred, but not required.
  • Open to all experience levels.
  • Relocation assistance available and considered during the interview process.
  • Ideal-fit traits include a balanced adjusting and therapy approach, business-minded attitude, PI experience, pediatric experience, and geriatric experience.
  • Strong communication skills, character and personality,

Other Information

  • Salary range: $87,000-$100,000 annually, based on experience, hours, production, and business generated.
  • Incentive and bonus opportunities are also available
  • Open to discussing percentage credit toward a future practice purchase or ownership transition.
  • CE reimbursement available.

job.description:

A well-established practice that has served the community for many years. The office has developed a loyal patient following through a commitment to wellness-focused care, strong patient relationships, and consistent clinical results.

The practice provides a supportive environment where doctors have the opportunity to collaborate with fellow providers while maintaining independence in their day-to-day patient management.
